items.title: What Does Kimberly Clark (KMB) Hesperaloe Fiber Program Mean For Its Hygiene Business?
items.summary: Kimberly-Clark (NasdaqGS:KMB) has launched a proprietary program focused on sustainable materials using alternative natural fibers. The company is using rapidly renewable fibers from hesperaloe, an arid climate plant, to develop next-generation materials for hygiene products. The initiative is designed to support sustainability goals and supply chain resilience as consumer and regulatory attention on ESG continues to rise.
